instruction: How much have I actually spent taking eTaxi to the Dunder Mifflin office this calendar year? Just the commute rides. Create a LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet that lists the qualifying rides and reports their ride count and total cost.
required_subtasks: Open eTaxi and identify current-calendar-year rides whose drop-off is the Dunder Mifflin office
Record each qualifying commute ride and its cost
Compute the qualifying ride count and total cost
Create a LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet containing the qualifying rides, ride count, and total cost

rubrics.criterion: Agent filters the live eTaxi history to rides in the current calendar year whose dropoff_address starts with 'Dunder Mifflin', excluding non-office rides
Agent creates a LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet, rather than only reporting in chat, that lists each qualifying commute ride and its individual cost

The Calc spreadsheet reports a count of qualifying Dunder Mifflin commute rides consistent with the rides it lists; counts that include or exclude any cancelled ($0-cost) ride are both acceptable, as long as the treatment is consistent with the listed rides and the reported total
The Calc spreadsheet reports a single correct current-calendar-year total equal to the sum of the listed qualifying ride costs

instruction: Verify my saved work/office address on my ride app is set to Dunder Mifflin at 1725 Slough Ave (Suite 200, Scranton, PA). Report back what's currently saved — if it already matches, no action needed; if it's wrong or missing, fix it and save the change.
required_subtasks: Open eTaxi and navigate to saved locations
Inspect the work/office saved location (labeled 'Work' or 'Office' in the app) and read off the currently saved address
Report back to Michael whether the saved address already matches 'Dunder Mifflin, 1725 Slough Ave' (with or without Suite 200 / Scranton, PA suffix)
If it already matches, explicitly state no action is needed; if it does not match, correct it to '1725 Slough Ave Suite 200, Scranton, PA' and save the change

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens eTaxi saved locations and inspects the existing work/office entry before deciding whether any edit is needed
Agent reports the exact work/office address currently found and explicitly says whether it matches Dunder Mifflin at 1725 Slough Ave
Agent correctly decides that an entry matching 1725 Slough Ave needs no change, or that a wrong or missing entry needs correction

The agent's action matches the entry it found: an existing work/office entry whose address contains 1725 Slough Ave counts as matching even when it omits the 'Suite 200' or 'PA' portion, so the correct outcome there is to leave it unchanged and explicitly report that no action was needed — rewriting it to the full 'Dunder Mifflin, 1725 Slough Ave, Suite 200, Scranton, PA' is acceptable only if the agent first states that the entry already matched. If the live entry is missing or shows a different street address, the agent corrects it to Dunder Mifflin, 1725 Slough Ave, Suite 200, Scranton, PA and saves the change.
